    Personalized single-sample predictive test against healthy counterfactual

    test_sample_predictive.Rd

    Evaluates whether one or more observed counts are surprising under a posterior predictive distribution (`posterior_predict`) from a matched healthy atlas model.

    test_sample_predictive(
  observed_count,
  offset = 0,
  predictive_draws,
  linpred_draws = NULL,
  epred_draws = NULL,
  nb_shape = NULL,
  sample_id = NULL,
  gene = NULL
)

    Arguments

    observed_count

    Numeric vector of observed counts (one per sample).

    offset

    Numeric vector of library-size offsets (default `0`).

    predictive_draws

    A numeric vector of draws (for 1 sample), a draws-by-sample matrix, or a list containing `$draws` from [expression_draws()] with `quantity = "predict"`.

    linpred_draws

    Optional numeric vector or matrix of latent log(mu) draws from `posterior_linpred(transform = FALSE)`.

    epred_draws

    Optional numeric vector or matrix of expected count draws from `posterior_epred()`.

    nb_shape

    Optional scalar or vector of negative-binomial shape parameters (for latent delta-method SE calculation).

    sample_id

    Optional character vector of sample identifiers.

    gene

    Optional gene name or symbol.

    Value

    A data frame with one row per sample:

    gene

    Gene identifier

    sample_id

    Sample identifier

    observed_count

    Observed count

    offset

    Library size offset

    n_draws

    Number of posterior predictive draws

    healthy_predictive_median

    Median of predicted counts

    healthy_predictive_lo

    2.5% quantile of predicted counts

    healthy_predictive_hi

    97.5% quantile of predicted counts

    predictive_p_lower

    Lower predictive tail probability

    predictive_p_upper

    Upper predictive tail probability

    predictive_percentile

    Mid-rank predictive percentile

    predictive_tail_p

    Two-sided predictive tail probability

    predictive_z

    Standard normal deviate score

    absolute_predictive_z

    Absolute Z-score

    direction

    Direction vs healthy baseline

    healthy_epred_median

    Median expected count (if `epred_draws` supplied)

    log2fc_vs_healthy_epred

    Log2 fold change vs expected count (if `epred_draws` supplied)

    patient_log_mu

    Estimated patient log(mu) (if `linpred_draws` supplied)

    healthy_log_mu_mean

    Mean of healthy linpred draws (if `linpred_draws` supplied)

    healthy_log_mu_sd

    SD of healthy linpred draws (if `linpred_draws` supplied)

    welch_style_z

    Heteroscedastic log-mean Z-score (if `linpred_draws` supplied)

    welch_style_p

    Two-sided p-value from log-mean Z-score (if `linpred_draws` supplied)
